## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this 

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```
bird breeding site location table
```{r}
bird_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(bird_breeding_sites)
```
bird breeding migratory connectivity table
```{r}
bird_migration_sites <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(bird_migration_sites))
```
filtering data for breeding site locations
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```
filtering data for migration sites
```{r}
bird_migration_selected <- bird_migration_sites |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

gt(head(bird_migration_selected))

#excluding spain from breeding sites
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(head(bird_breeding_exc))

#excluding spain from migration sites
bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(head(bird_migration_exc))
```
grouping the migration frame
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)

lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))
gt(lat_df)
```

medians of latitude and longitude
```{r}
bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  )

gt(bird_migration_summary)
```
joining together the breeding sites and migration sites data frames
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_summary)

gt(combined_bird_data)
```
 pivoting
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```
 subsetting data frame into spring and autumn
```{r}
spring_vals <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
autumn_vals <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")

spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_vals)

autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_vals)

write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```
 calculating min and max longitude and latitude
```{r}
#minimum longitude
min_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

print(min_lon)

#maximum longitude
max_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()

print(max_lon)

#minimum latitude
min_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

print(min_lat)

#maximum latitude
max_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()

print(max_lat)
```
 
 
 plotting spring data
```{r}
gt(spring_data)

ggplot(
  spring_data,
       aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = Site, shape = Location_Type)
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) + 
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
                 ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
                 ) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
 plotting autumn data
```{r}
min_lon <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

max_lon <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()

min_lat <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

max_lat <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()

ggplot(
  autumn_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = Site, shape = Location_Type)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
  ) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Autumn Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
